history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

classes-18.description: Every class twice: 18 fresh seeds, 100,000 engine turns, classes dealt and races cycled as in classes-1800. A smoke suite for assigned births.

experiment.description: In the jellies-x4 and jellies-x8 worlds on borg-reborn-rs ea4e8534 (track-p 57d47863, with #964 and #965-#968 merged and every switch shipped 0), do the switches written for the white-jelly deaths save the games where an immobile toucher stands beside the Borg's route, which the normal world shows only rarely? The arms: the stair route keeps off a retreat's square (#964, hold), the retreat breaker with back-aways (#1023, osc-ba), both together (hold-osc), the reach-free stair route (#931, reach), the escape before the retreat when poisoned without a cure (#934, poison), and the bundle of #654 (all). Each world has its own control. Generated from definitions/reborn-jelly-worlds-pilot.yaml: 14 arms on 4.2.6-reborn-rust-jelly-worlds-ea4e8534, suite classes-18.
experiment.name: reborn-jelly-worlds-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-23: borg-reborn-rs owner, "we need the ZOO" (release of #712's hold) and "yeah dispatch to zoo" (borg-zoo#712; the pilot only, later tiers after the gate and the owner).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any game of this build was played in these worlds (borg-zoo#712, scenario of #677; borg-reborn-rs #931, #932/#964, #1023,
#933, #934; RULES 21). Seven arms, the requester's short list (ctl = shipped, every switch 0; hold = caution_retreat_reentry_ticks 128; oscba =
caution_retreat_oscillation_limit 3 with _backaway 1; holdosc = hold and oscba; reach = caution_stairs_immobile_reach 1, its detour limit
caution_stairs_immobile_reach_extra_steps at the shipped 20; poison = caution_poisoned_no_cure_retreat_hp_percent 75; all = reach, oscba,
caution_retreat_immobile_kill_turns 3 and poison, without hold) in jellies-x8 and jellies-x4 (14 profiles), classes-18, 18 starts each (252 cells),
100,000 turns, evidence retained. osc (limit 3 alone), osc5 (_thinks 5) and kill (alone) are left to a later run. A world's arms are compared only
within that world (ctl-x8 against x8 arms, ctl-x4 against x4 arms). Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell records its world with the same
borg_world_data_sha256 in every arm of that world; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls
apart; identical plays. Report per world, arm and class: deaths and causes (white, yellow, blue and green jelly, and poison, apart; any death with a
jelly adjacent apart), CL and DL, paired rescued and newly killed against the world's ctl; per arm the counts of "# Stair flight avoiding retreat
grid" (hold, holdosc), "# No retreat: N moves away in a row from here were undone" (oscba, holdosc, all), "# No retreat: immobile" (all),
"# Poisoned, no cure" (poison, all) and strategic retreats and back-ups taken next to a jelly; world check: jellies met per game ("Creating a
monster '... jelly'") and killed. The jellies are DL2-5, so most games meet them. A world is a stress test: a lead here needs the normal-world tiers
of #654 (paired by start against ctl) before a shipped value is judged. Directional (RULES 14).
